title: Riccardo Riccò Fires Back After Tadej Pogačar’s Ice Cream Quip About Doping
content:
Tadej Pogačar joked that riders who dope could end up selling ice cream. Riccardo Riccò, banned for life and now running a gelato shop, fired back.

Read the full article at Riccardo Riccò Fires Back After Tadej Pogačar’s Ice Cream Quip About Doping on Velo.
